final: WITH o AS (SELECT u.acctscope AS scope, od.recordvault AS rv, AVG(f.feerate) - AVG(f.rebrate) AS net FROM fees f JOIN orders od ON f.orderslink = od.recordvault JOIN users u ON od.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY u.acctscope, od.recordvault), s AS (SELECT scope, AVG(net) AS avg_net, COUNT(*) AS n_orders FROM o WHERE net IS NOT NULL GROUP BY scope) SELECT scope, avg_net, n_orders, avg_net - (SELECT AVG(avg_net) FROM s) AS diff_from_avg FROM s
